**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or cost inefficiency is. E.g. *"I am spending too much on Anthropic Claude Opus when doing small unit tests."*

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen (e.g. support a new provider, add a routing rule, or support a new IDE).

**Target Provider / Model / IDE**
- Provider: [e.g. Together AI, Fireworks, Ollama, Groq, Mistral]
- Parity Comparison: [e.g. Replaces Model X at Y% lower cost]
- Target IDE: [e.g. Zed, Neovim, JetBrains]

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, benchmarks, or API documentation links here.
